# Copilot instructions

Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root — it is the operating contract
for this project and it binds every AI tool that opens it.

Non-negotiables: this repo is the only home for the project (never create a
second copy; move in related material you find elsewhere → `design-archive/`);
never end a session without committing and pushing; never end a session without
writing a `record_snapshot` to Photion project PRJ-911 (House Design App). The old
Notion hub page is dead as of 2026-09-03.

The owner is a non-coder — plain language everywhere. Fix the class, never the
instance. Backend `.mjs` edits need a server restart.
